description: This Java source file defines the DeviceControlActivity class for an Android application that interfaces with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. It manages the connection lifecycle, discovers GATT services and characteristics, and provides a user interface for interacting with the BLE device by displaying its services and handling data transfer.

classes.name: DeviceControlActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for controlling Bluetooth LE device, handling GATT service interactions, connection states, and user interface updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, retrieves intent extras, and binds to BluetoothLeService.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers broadcast receiver and attempts to reconnect to the BLE device.

methods.name: updateConnectionState
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect connection status.

methods.name: displayData
methods.description: Displays data received from BLE device.

methods.name: displayGattServices
methods.description: Populates UI list with available GATT services and characteristics.
